arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and describing the issue in detail. I understand how disruptive it is to be signed out unexpectedly, especially on a tight deadline.

Based on current support documentation, there is *no* policy that would automatically sign you out of Cursor simply for using the same Google SSO account across multiple machines. Device verification steps are required only for sensitive billing actions, not for regular sign-in or daily usage.

Since this behavior started recently and is affecting your ability to work, it's likely due to either a recent bug or some unexpected change on the server side—not an intentional policy update. This type of cross-device sign-out is not expected or normal for Pro customers.

Given the severity and urgency, I am escalating your ticket to our human support engineers for immediate investigation. They will follow up directly to get this resolved as soon as possible.

Thank you for your patience and for being a valued Pro customer. If you have any more details—such as time of last sign-out or recent device/browser changes—please include them in any follow-up replies to help our engineers narrow this down.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for letting us know you're unable to download your March invoice PDF — I know how important these are for expense reporting. 

A download button that spins endlessly usually points to a browser or network-related hang, but your description (tested on Chrome and Safari) suggests the problem may be on our end. Please try the following steps first:

1. Clear your browser cache for billing.cursor.com, then reload the invoices page.
2. Try opening the invoice page in a private/incognito window.
3. If you are using a VPN or ad blocker, temporarily disable it and try the download again.

If these steps don’t resolve the issue, please reply to this email or write to support@cursor.com with a screenshot or screen recording. We'll make sure you get your invoice one way or another, and can provide a PDF copy directly if needed.

Thank you for your patience!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4820] Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your message and your feature suggestion!

At the moment, Cursor doesn't have a dedicated keyboard shortcut to trigger inline edit directly. The current method — using Cmd-K to open the menu and selecting Inline Edit with the mouse — is the standard workflow.

I've logged your request for a single-step keyboard shortcut with our product team, as this could definitely streamline editing for power users like you. We'll keep you updated if this feature is added in a future release.

If you have any other workflow suggestions or accessibility requests, please feel free to send them our way anytime.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support
